title: Cybernetic Mushroom Oracle
description: A metallic cybernetic humanoid head with glowing yellow eye emerges from a pond of lily pads, surrounded by large vibrant mushrooms with spotted red and yellow caps. Translucent bubbles float throughout the surreal scene against a dramatic swirling sky of red, purple and green nebulae.
